known_pitfall_claim: For every i∈[1,3], every S-valued sequence in the domain of the arbitrarily introduced partial mapping φ_i is mapped to an element of S.
pitfall_counterexample: Let the ambient type be ℕ and S={0}. Let x:ℕ→ℕ be x(n)=0. Represent each partial map by a domain predicate Dᵢ and value function φᵢ. Set D₁(x)=true and φ₁(x)=1; all other inputs may be outside D₁. Let D₂ and D₃ be empty. Then i=1∈[1,3], x is S-valued since x(n)=0∈S for every n, and x∈D₁, but φ₁(x)=1∉S.
